name: hoc/schema-form
description: A JSON Schema draft-2020-12 driven form HOC with x-ui extension support, dynamic field linkage, nested object/array rendering, option loaders, custom widget registry, and optional Zod-compatible validation integration.
useCases: Dynamic admin configuration forms generated from backend-managed JSON schemas
Enterprise onboarding flows requiring field dependency logic and conditional required rules
Operations dashboards that mix static enum options with async option sources
Product forms that need nested object and array editing with extensible widgets
usage: import { SchemaForm, type SchemaFormSchema, type SchemaFormProps } from "shadcn-solid-components/hoc/schema-form"
